mcc_p.protocol: code(raw the manifest-selected embedding split z) vs pooled base/counterfactual factor
mcc_p.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

mcc_s.protocol: code(raw the manifest-selected embedding split z) vs pooled base/counterfactual factor
mcc_s.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dci_d.protocol: 80/20 seeded split within the manifest-selected embedding split; raw one-factor DCI-D is trivially 1 and is rendered N/A in presentation tables
dci_d.protocol_note: When factor labels are absent, evaluation falls back to one pooled base/counterfactual factor. Raw DCI-D is then trivially 1.0, the run is marked dci_d_is_trivial=true, and presentation tables render N/A.

dci_c.protocol: 80/20 seeded split within the manifest-selected embedding split
dci_c.protocol_note: Computed against stored per-pair concept factors when available, or the explicitly marked pooled fallback otherwise.

dci_i.protocol: 80/20 seeded split within the manifest-selected embedding split
dci_i.protocol_note: The GBT always uses a seeded 80/20 split within the selected embedding split; consult transductive to distinguish cfc_train fallback runs.

r2.definition: Linear explicitness of factors from the full learned code.
r2.protocol: in-sample on the manifest-selected embedding split, matching the repository's canonical R2 metric
r2.caveat: With 2304 codes and fewer test rows, this can saturate at 1.
r2.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

sae_auc.protocol: code(raw the manifest-selected embedding split z) vs pooled base/counterfactual factor
sae_auc.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

decoder_projection_mcc_p.definition: Best Pearson MCC after projecting raw embeddings onto decoder atoms.
decoder_projection_mcc_p.protocol: raw the manifest-selected embedding split z
decoder_projection_mcc_p.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

support_precision.definition: Precision of the MCC-matched feature's binary support.
support_precision.protocol: raw the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 0.1
support_precision.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

support_recall.definition: Recall of the MCC-matched feature's binary support.
support_recall.protocol: raw the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 0.1
support_recall.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

support_f1.definition: F1 of the MCC-matched feature's binary support.
support_f1.protocol: raw the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 0.1
support_f1.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

reconstruction_mse.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split inputs in the model's training regime (raw or delta-z)
reconstruction_mse.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

reconstruction_nmse.definition: MSE divided by mean squared input magnitude.
reconstruction_nmse.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split inputs in the model's training regime (raw or delta-z)
reconstruction_nmse.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

reconstruction_cosine.definition: Mean per-example cosine between input and reconstruction.
reconstruction_cosine.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split inputs in the model's training regime (raw or delta-z)
reconstruction_cosine.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

mean_l0.definition: Mean number of active code coordinates per example.
mean_l0.protocol: in-regime the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 1e-08
mean_l0.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

mean_l1.definition: Mean per-example sum of absolute code values.
mean_l1.protocol: in-regime the manifest-selected embedding split codes
mean_l1.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

mean_abs_code.definition: Mean absolute code value over examples and coordinates.
mean_abs_code.protocol: in-regime the manifest-selected embedding split codes
mean_abs_code.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

active_feature_fraction.definition: Fraction of coordinates active for at least one test example.
active_feature_fraction.protocol: in-regime the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 1e-08
active_feature_fraction.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dead_feature_fraction.definition: Fraction of coordinates never active on the test inputs.
dead_feature_fraction.protocol: in-regime the manifest-selected embedding split codes; |code| > 1e-08
dead_feature_fraction.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

decoder_diff_cosine.definition: Best decoder atom's mean signed cosine with paired delta-z.
decoder_diff_cosine.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split paired differences
decoder_diff_cosine.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dictionary_best_cosine.definition: Largest absolute cosine between a decoder atom and mean delta-z.
dictionary_best_cosine.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split paired differences
dictionary_best_cosine.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dictionary_angular_error_deg.protocol: the manifest-selected embedding split paired differences
dictionary_angular_error_deg.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dictionary_norm_ratio.definition: Best atom norm divided by mean delta-z norm.

dictionary_norm_ratio.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.

dictionary_frac_close_0_9.definition: Fraction of decoder atoms with |cos(mean delta-z)| > 0.9.

dictionary_frac_close_0_9.protocol_note: The exact split, transductive flag, and factor provenance are recorded per run.
